title: Ore
body:
Description

Ore is found in Stone. It can be obtained by mining within the Classic Biome.

The raw form of Ore has a gray studded texture with white parts on it.

The refined version of Ore changes the color of the ore from gray to white, and changes its name from Oreable to simply just Ore.

Like any other material in the game, you can use refined and forged Ore to complete schematics.

Trivia

  • It is one of eight ores to have a different name depending on its current state of processing, the name in question being "Oreable" on its unrefined form.
    • The other ores are Red Clay, Blue Clay, Brown Clay, Sand, OpalRed, OpalBlue, and OpalBrown, which when forged, have the names "Red Bricks", "Blue Bricks", "Brown Bricks", "Glass", "Magma Opal", "Tide Opal", and "Crystal Opal", respectively.
  • It was added to the game as a reward for hitting 2 million visits.
    • It was added back on June 28th for hitting 3 million visits, and was removed on July 3rd.
    • It was added back on July 16th for hitting 4 million visits, and was removed on August 1st, 2023.
    • It was again, added back on January 26th, 2024 for hitting 10 million visits, and removed on February 14th, 2024.
    • It was added back on August 30th, 2024 for hitting 20 million visits, and Hoofer didnt give an ETA for when they will be removed.
    • It was not confirmed if it is limited or not, but it most likely is due to its long removal periods.
    • It was originally unobtainable unless trading with another player or waiting for another visit milestone to be hit, but has since become indefinitely obtainable on the dedicated classic area off the shore of Ferwater Island.
